title: Problem add batch
description: Input for the Discord command /problem add_batch. The document is a JSON array of new problems; each entry creates one problem with a specific topic. The bot validates and persists the complete batch atomically before confirming success. Refresh the class export to discover the created IDs.

class.description: Code of an existing class, as listed in classes.json.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the problem statement.

difficulty.description: Optional difficulty. Omit or use null to leave it unset.

topic.description: Required specific topic. Do not use "General" or a blank value.

priority.description: Optional priority. Omit or use null to leave it unset.
